labels_in_g2.sql:
SELECT Graph_KG.CY_TYPED(%EXACT(p2.val)) AS n_id
FROM Graph_KG.nodes n0
JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_labels l1 ON l1.s = n0.node_id AND l1.label = ? AND COALESCE(l1.graph_id, '') = COALESCE('c17g2', '')
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p2 ON p2.s = n0.node_id AND p2."key" = ? AND COALESCE(p2.graph_id, '') = COALESCE('c17g2', '')
WHERE l1.s IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(n0.graph_id, '') = COALESCE('c17g2', '') AND 1=1
